g.text: A separately excited DC machine links electrical and shaft variables through flux

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Separately excited field; motor armature current enters the positive supply terminal and E opposes it. For positive generator delivery current, V_a=E−I_aR_a instead.
In coherent SI units k_eΦ=k_tΦ. Example V_a=100 V,I_a=10 A,R_a=0.5 Ω,kΦ=0.5 gives E=95 V,ω=190 rad/s,T=5 N·m; converted power 950 W plus 50 W copper loss equals 1 kW
